basis: Full right singular vectors of original normalized old H. Same cutoff max(H.shape)*float64_eps*smax; N=Vh[rank:].T. No rank/threshold/mixing search; original row-space Q reconstructs H, N orthonormal and HN residual<1e-10.
scope: Complementary fixed constraint: optimize same objective with W=W0+N A, H N=0. From original ridge; exact old-H response preservation within numerical tolerance, not presumed query safety. q404 frozen inside-span candidate secondary.
objective: Same class-balanced CE(8*z@W)+.064/2 Rnorm(W-W0), original 1536/(2 sum p||z||^2) scale, all H+newS/all rivals. W=W0+N A with fixed HN=0.
initialization: A=0, original ridge; q404 head/results inaccessible until candidate seal.
coordinates: Same reduced-Gram Cholesky coordinates with N replacing Q: G=(zN)^Tdiag(p)(zN), L L^T=G+.001I, V=L^T A, ztilde=zN L^-T, fixed offset=8zW0. No extra objective penalty.

optimizer.name: matrix_free_Newton_CG
optimizer.combined_count: objective+gradient evaluations + analytic Hessian-vector products + line-search objective evaluations + curvature probability evaluations
optimizer.nonpositive_curvature: truncate CG; use negative gradient only if assembled direction is not descent

convergence: max_abs(N N^T grad_W)<=1e-6, original-W nullspace tangent coordinates; full gradient separately reported without unconstrained convergence claim.
primary: Original ridge only; constrained tangent convergence and both exposed queries BA_all strictly increases, old/new decreases at most1pp. This is a development criterion, not independent method success.
query_access: Only after fitted candidate saved and sealed; q404 private head/results also blocked until then. Only ridge/centroid models, original retained H, new S before seal. No old S, E, teacher, raw images or new labels.
validation: Reuse offset objective/HVP/root checks plus fixed 2D complementary update preserving old-H response. Formal full-right SVD/H reconstruction, N orthogonality/HN residual, Cholesky/feature/gradient/objective identities and old-H all-class baseline logit max error<1e-10. Reference ridge/q404 support and query per-class aggregates match at1e-10.
